identity: Thiago is Tiggy, the human main character

references.cartoons: User-supplied approved character and game-world references in docs/art
references.photograph: Kept outside checkout. Not included in public assets or Git.

character.source: User-authored Illustrator vectors; neutral geometry and original thinking/laughing facial paths
character.renderer: Shared original-path Canvas2D joint animation in React and Phaser
character.animation: Independent head, shoulder/elbow/wrist, hip/knee/ankle transforms. Original shirt is partitioned by masks into sleeves and torso; original facial expression paths are reused. No new character artwork generated.

worlds.provenance: Original generated raster illustrations, not Lingokids assets.
worlds.direction: Flatter original 2D pass; simplified shapes, consistent dark outlines and reduced texture.

vehicles.provenance: Original generated chassis; paint-only palette swaps; separately articulated procedural treaded wheels.
vehicles.track: Runtime-rendered ramp and circular tyre contacts share src/game/truckTrack.ts; no separate sine path.

audio.source: Approved prerecorded character candidates or pre-existing device recordings. No new adult or pitch-shifted voice bundled.
audio.format: MP3/WAV import, candidate JSON packs, browser-native recorder
audio.storage: Device-only IndexedDB bytes; candidate approval persisted separately from imports
audio.previousNarration: Rejected system voice assets and automatic browser speech fallback removed

interface.wordmark: Outlined Outfit wordmark with custom T/play monogram; OFL licence and font source in docs/art/brand-font

activities.provenance: Original generated flat 2D sprite art. Four Benny expression/action drawings; not a complete skeletal animation rig.
activities.ferris: Procedural 2D wheel, moving spokes, upright interactive cabins and count display.

branding.processing: Original outlined shapes and colours retained; nonvisual Adobe metadata omitted, icon cropped from the same head artwork.

music.source: Original procedural instrumental motifs in src/game/soundscape.ts
music.runtime: Web Audio after a real gesture; separate voice/music/effects levels; dialogue ducking
